The issue involved in the present Writ respect of the interpretation of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as observed by the Co-ordinate Bench (Coram : K.K. Tated & B.P. Colabawalla, JJ.) on 7 th March 2018 in order passed in the present proceeding.
